subject: Risk & Compliance
title: What Makes a Code Effective
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: What Makes a Code Effective.

hook.text: Most employees can't name a single rule from their company's code of conduct. That's a problem.

buildup.text: Effective codes are clear, specific, and illustrated with real scenarios rather than abstract principles.

discovery.text: Google's original 'Don't Be Evil' code was memorable precisely because it was simple and direct.

twist.text: Codes that are too long become shelfware. Codes that are too short lack useful guidance for real decisions.

climax.text: The best codes provide principles plus examples. They answer 'what should I do when?' not just 'what's the rule?'

punchline.text: Clear. Specific. Memorable. That's an effective code.

quiz.question: What makes a code of conduct effective?
options: Clear principles with real scenarios and examples
Being as long and detailed as possible
